system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no system prompt construction described. Paper says the harness synthesizes input from the transcript, but that describes messages, not the system prompt.

env_context_strategy.note: Paper only; the tool list and task templates are not described.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: long tool results are pruned in the projection while the full text remains in the file

observation_format.evidence_quote: An entry records the round, the input, the tool uses with their results, and the streamed text.
observation_format.note: Format of tool results is not specified; the value is inferred from 'streamed text'. Paper mentions an imagegen tool, but not image observations.

tool_call_format.note: The paper says 'if the model asks for a tool' but does not describe the parser or format.

tool_schema_source.note: Nodes register 'a list of provided capabilities'; the schema source is not stated.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: The wire protocol is NDJSON over TCP, one object per line, frames up to 64 MB
protocol_standardization.note: Custom ROS-style bus protocol, not a published standard; MCP is used only as a baseline configuration. 'other' is the closest value; 'none' is also arguable.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: call the model, stream the answer into the transcript 5: if the model asks for a tool then 6: route the call, append the result to the transcript
loop_primitives.note: event_driven is included for broadcast events delivered to every registered node.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: A harness runs the loop of input synthesis, model calls, and output settlement over one session
multi_agent_topology.note: Multiple harnesses can share tools on the bus, but each session is run by one agent.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Messages shown to the model are a projec-tion over the transcript

state_persistence.evidence_quote: a new process of the same id imports the transcript, rebuilds the projection, and continues the session, a cold switch.

rollback.evidence_quote: Recovery has no rollback and no fork, the rebuilt view equals the view the failed process held
rollback.note: This covers session recovery only. Component mounts carry tracked inverses (reversible assembly), but these are not a revert of file changes.

timeouts.note: The 5 s write timeout is bus-level (it disconnects the peer), not a timeout on tool calls.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: the router and every node as separate processes over the loopback bus
execution_isolation.note: Each plugin runs as its own OS process; no sandbox is described.

tracing.evidence_quote: An observer node records every broadcast into an append-only file, the event stream.
tracing.note: There is also a JSONL transcript per session.

replayability.evidence_quote: Every assertion is checked against two independent on-disk sources, the transcript and the event stream, and every scenario carries a re-play command.
replayability.note: Replay is checked against invariants I1-I4; the paper makes no bit-for-bit determinism claim.

eval_hooks.note: The BFCL evaluation is described, but no repository is available to confirm a built-in hook.

target_domain.evidence_quote: The tasks are the first 200 of BFCL

open_source.note: The CC-BY license covers the paper only; no repository URL was provided.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: The models in these measurements are DeepSeek V4 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro, GLM-5.2, GLM-5.3, Claude Opus 5, Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-Image-2, and GPT-5.4

primary_artifact.note: No repository was in the evidence.

first_release_date.note: The paper v1 date is not given; only v3 (2026-09-06) is shown.

pinned_version.note: No repository or commit is available; pinned to the paper version.
